questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Brugia malayi?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Operculated fluke eggs in a stool wet mount.
Microfilariae in peripheral blood; collect with local periodicity and laboratory guidance in mind.
Giardia cysts with four nuclei in a stool preparation.
questions.explanation: Microfilariae in peripheral blood; collect with local periodicity and laboratory guidance in mind. Stained blood films or concentration; inspect full head/tail and use molecular support where needed.
